messages:
Maya: kicking off a joint perf/W exploration with Helios Labs next week. objective: find sweet-spot configs for our marketplace offering (cost-efficient SKU).
Ethan: good. narrow scope: 7B model, seq 512/1024, batch 1/4, quant FP16/INT8, power cap sweep. outputs: perf/W curve + recommended instance layout.
Rina: Helios units report on-board power but no prometheus. can we accept CSV logs if they can't run exporters?
Maya: yes, accept CSV and external meter logs. request a sample format.
Oliver: I'll supply a minimal repro (single-command) and a tiny prom exporter container if Helios allows it. repro: ```bash
python infra/bench/harness.py --model redwood-7b --seq 1024 --batch 4 --quant int8 --power-cap 250 --out helios.json
```
Kai: note: Helios has a known NVLink imbalance at 2-instance packing; recommend we test 1 and 2 instances per GPU.
Sophie: marketing wants a 1-paragraph co-auth blurb + two charts (efficiency vs power, scaling by instances). embargo until Wed next week for legal review.
Maya: timeline: internal dry-run Mon, partner dry-run Tue, sweep Wed-Thu, quick results sync Fri.
Rina: I'll prepare a KPI template: cols = model, seq, batch, instances, quant, tokens_s, p50_ms, p95_ms, avg_power_w, joules_per_token, notes.
Oliver: I'll try a small kernel prefetch toggle on a branch (oliver/hbm-slate-toggle) to test multi-instance perf.
bench-bot: action created: partnerships/helios-slate-efficiency - assignees: Maya, Oliver, Rina - due: +8d
Maya: thanks all. I'll draft the runbook and send to Helios with the CSV schema and NDA note. please ack availability for Wed-Thu sweep.
Ethan: ack
Oliver: ack, will push exporter and branch by Mon EOD
Rina: ack, will make KPI sheet and notebook
Sophie: ack, will draft blurb and loop in legal
Maya: great — :thumbsup:
